title: python/src/lichen/ccp.py: slot_hash silently produces wrong hash for short eui64 inputs
description:
The zip() on line 306 truncates to the shorter of eui64 and sfn_bytes (8 bytes). If eui64 is less than 8 bytes, only the provided bytes are XORed, producing a different hash than expected. No validation ensures eui64 is exactly 8 bytes.

Fix suggestion: Add validation: `if len(eui64) != 8: raise ValueError('eui64 must be exactly 8 bytes')`
close_reason: Duplicate of dl1g - fixed by adding eui64 length validation to select_channel()
